scope: Strict isolated-word comparison on the seven existing fixed populations. Current and previous Writer outputs reconstruct from their frozen replay; nepscript is evaluated locally; Google and Writer 2.2 remain dated saved responses. No new Google requests, labels, training, source selection by score or sentence-parity claim.

suites.label: Google comparison
suites.description: 512 fixed public inputs · matched five-candidate limit
suites.independence: Sample fixed by proportional source-stratified hashing before Google collection and segment training. Test results are now observed. No Google output is used for training. This is a fixed comparison, not proof of general product parity.

suites.label: Everyday typing check
suites.independence: Project-authored references, not independently annotated or representative traffic. Examples were used to diagnose the generic autocorrection ranking bug; treat this suite as a regression check.

suites.label: Full public test
suites.description: Aksharantar Nepali · all 4,085 eligible unique inputs · local engines
suites.independence: Previously observed public split. Pair mappings and native-unit language counts are trained only on TRAIN; decoder settings selected on validation. This is a continuing fixed regression comparison.

suites.label: Development
suites.independence: Used during development; not independent accuracy.

suites.label: Observed 41-case regression
suites.description: Original 2.1 confirmation · now observed development data
suites.independence: These 41 inputs were untouched for 2.1, but are observed regression/feature-design evidence for 2.2. Not an independent holdout for the current engine. Original 2.1 results and Google capture remain preserved.

suites.label: Observed 89-case regression
suites.description: Original fresh test · now an explicit regression gate
suites.independence: The original 89-case test was used to diagnose weaknesses and as a top-five coverage gate in this release. These are regression gains, not independent evidence. Frozen 2.0 and Google outputs are preserved.

suites.label: Category checks · 97 inputs
suites.description: New typed inputs across six categories · compare frozen 2.1 and Google
suites.independence: Project-authored category probes locked before outputs. No exact Roman input appears in earlier benchmark cases. New curated vocabulary excludes these exact input spellings; known native vocabulary and productive stems are allowed, especially for typo and spelling-variant probes. Original TRAIN and old seeds can contain the words. This measures new typing inputs, not whole-word TRAIN-disjoint generalization. Not independent native annotation or representative traffic. No tuning against these outputs.
